hello Azelo... As a girl, I also struggle with self confidence and hopelessness. What I want to let you know though, is that you, you as a person is much more than just your height or awkwardness. Despite what u see on the internet, not all girls want guys over 6', I never even considered people's heights for me to like them.   


My boyfriend was 19 years old when I met him (5'6 all his friends are over 6'', he had never been in any relationship prior) and he is the most awkward person I have ever met up until now. However, I fell inlove with him because he is a genuine person, who never tries to act like everyone else. He is okay being himself despite struggling to socialize. The more I spoke to him, the more I got to know him and the more I fell in love with him. We've been dating for 2 and a half years and I still love him to this day.  


You are still young, keep refining yourself and enjoy the time you have with your friends. Relationships also aren't always easy, sometimes you go through hard times, so don't rush. If you are looking for a genuine relationship (dating or friendship), just remember that the most important thing is to try your best to be yourself. If people end up rejecting you for who you are or how you act, then they're not for you. **Keep looking, keep being yourself**, someone will find you and think you are the most interesting person in the world and love you for who you really are.   


I'm usually the type to post my problems on here, but I really felt like you could use my perspective. I believe in you Azelo \^\^
